name: Cleanup Action Runs

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - "Update PPM Binding Package"
    types:
      - completed

permissions:
  actions: write
  contents: write
  issues: write

jobs:
  cleanup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # ============================================================
      # 1. DELETE COMPLETED ACTION RUNS
      # ============================================================

      - name: Delete completed workflow runs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          gh api \
            "/repos/$REPO/actions/runs?status=completed&per_page=100" \
            --paginate \
            --jq '.workflow_runs[].id' |
          while read -r RUN_ID; do
            echo "Deleting run $RUN_ID"

            gh api \
              --method DELETE \
              "/repos/$REPO/actions/runs/$RUN_ID"
          done


      # ============================================================
      # 2. DELETE ALL COMMENTS FROM RECEIVER ISSUE #3
      # ============================================================

      - name: Delete issue comments
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          echo "Deleting comments from issue #3"

          gh api \
            "/repos/$REPO/issues/3/comments?per_page=100" \
            --paginate \
            --jq '.[].id' |
          while read -r COMMENT_ID; do
            echo "Deleting comment $COMMENT_ID"

            gh api \
              --method DELETE \
              "/repos/$REPO/issues/comments/$COMMENT_ID"
          done

          echo "All comments deleted from issue #3"


      # ============================================================
      # 3. CHECKOUT CURRENT REPOSITORY STATE
      # ============================================================

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          fetch-depth: 0


      # ============================================================
      # 4. REPLACE HISTORY WITH CURRENT STATE
      # ============================================================

      - name: Delete commit history
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "========================================"
          echo " DELETE COMMIT HISTORY"
          echo "========================================"
          echo

          git config user.name "PPM Cleanup"
          git config user.email "actions@github.com"

          # Create a new branch with no parent/history
          git checkout --orphan ppm-clean-main

          # Stage the current repository state
          git add -A

          # Create the new root commit
          git commit \
            -m "PPM package executor"

          # Replace main with the new root commit
          git branch -D main
          git branch -m main

          # Force the new one-commit history onto GitHub
          git push \
            --force \
            origin main

          echo
          echo "========================================"
          echo " COMMIT HISTORY CLEANED"
          echo "========================================"
